psychological_meaning: Ultramarine is a deep blue pigment that evokes feelings of calm, trust, and stability. It is often associated with intelligence, authority, and sophistication. This color can inspire introspection and promote a sense of order and peace, making it suitable for environments that require focus and serenity.

real_world_examples.title: Yves Klein's Ultramarine Pigment
real_world_examples.description: Artist Yves Klein famously patented a specific shade of Ultramarine, known as International Klein Blue (IKB), highlighting its unique intensity and impact in art.

real_world_examples.title: Deep Sea Photography
real_world_examples.description: Ultramarine hues often dominate underwater photography, capturing the mystique and depth of the ocean's darker regions.

how_to_pair: Pair with white for a clean, sophisticated look.
Combine with silver or gold for a touch of luxury.
Use with lighter blues to create a calming, monochromatic palette.
